title: My kitten decided I needed to go live for 3 minutes without telling me
author: JadeFox42
text: Well, my kitten decided I needed to go live for 3 minutes without telling me. 🤣
blurb: A curious tabby kitten perched in front of a streaming setup apparently took matters into their own paws and started a three-minute live stream without telling their human. Here, the tiny producer studies the monitor like they run the channel.
